menu.subtitle: An alien egg was discovered during a military operation. Since you touched it, the creature reacts to your decisions. Professor Chen begins a short protocol before it chooses its form.

dialogue.clickHint: Read the next message to continue the protocol.
dialogue.choiceHint: Choose an answer to influence the result.

final.noMutationText: No new threshold. The current form stabilizes.

stable.label: Stable
stable.summary: The form remains coherent. The creature still responds to the bond.

strained.label: Strained
strained.summary: Specialization is rising. Continuing may lock the form too hard.

anomaly.label: Anomalies detected
anomaly.summary: The biological layers contradict each other. The creature evolves against itself.

critical.label: Critical degeneration
critical.summary: The protocol has crossed its bounds. The form no longer stabilizes.

confirmQuit.title: Quit the protocol?
confirmQuit.text: Your current progress will be reset and you will return to the main menu.

confirmStop.title: Stop testing this creature?
confirmStop.text: This action will stop the current tests on the creature and return you to the main menu.

lore.title: Discovery of the Egg
lore.text: During a security operation in a restricted zone, your unit discovered an egg of unknown origin. Its surface looked mineral, but a slow pulse vibrated beneath the shell.

lore.title: Accidental Contact
lore.text: You were assigned to protect the perimeter. When the egg began to crack, you touched it by reflex. At that moment, your heartbeat and its internal energy synchronized.

lore.title: Emotional Reaction
lore.text: Since the contact, the egg reacts to your mood shifts. Anger, fear, curiosity, calm: each emotion changes its temperature, color, and biological rhythm.

lore.title: Chen Protocol
lore.text: Before the full hatching, Professor Chen wants to understand the bond between you and the creature. You will go through behavioral tests to measure this synchronization.

force.name: Gatebreaker
force.description: The creature’s appearance evolved according to your emotional synchronization with the alien egg.

exploration.name: Mistwalker
exploration.description: The creature’s appearance evolved according to your emotional synchronization with the alien egg.

conciliation.name: Bond Echo
conciliation.description: The creature’s appearance evolved according to your emotional synchronization with the alien egg.

intelligence.name: Clearcore
intelligence.description: The creature’s appearance evolved according to your emotional synchronization with the alien egg.

stable.title: Viable bond
stable.text: The creature keeps a readable form and still responds to your presence. It is not perfect, but it can live with this bond.

specialized.title: Specialized form
specialized.text: The creature takes a clear direction. It becomes more capable, but each new test narrows its room to adapt.

unstable.title: Unstable form
unstable.text: Anomalies appear in its morphology. It gains intensity, but loses part of its internal coherence.

degenerate.title: Total degeneration
degenerate.text: Evolution has been pushed too far. The creature is no longer merely transformed: it is deforming under the protocol pressure.
